time_to_hazard.model: analytic: straight-line distance from the vehicle's position at its FIRST DENM reception to the hazard rectangle boundary, divided by max(current speed, 0.3*mean trip speed, 1 m/s); vehicles = those that actually switched route

definitions.equipped: VEHICLE_REGISTRATION rows whose application list contains WeatherWarningApp
definitions.latency: reception time - transmission time of the same MessageId (SNS ad-hoc ITS-G5, multi-hop)
definitions.route_switches: CentralNavigationComponent 'Change to route' lines in Navigation.log
definitions.travel_time: SUMO tripinfo (finished trips only; unfinished counted separately)

event.desc: NLP: "Bus and CNG collision at Karwan Bazar signal, road blocked" -> incident @ Karwan Bazar
